asks: Is it sharper, or only brighter?
description: A great brass ring in the ceiling holding a lens that is still being made, glass folding over itself and polishing itself smooth, throwing a beam that sharpens and softens as it works.
emotes: {it} tightens by one ring and the whole room comes into focus.
{it} turns, and the light walks around the walls in a circle.
{it} throws a bright figured pattern across everything and takes it back.
looks: The glass turns against a shape that is also glass, and both are getting more exact.
The beam narrows to a point of unbearable clarity and then opens out again to a wash.
There are rings inside rings, each one correcting the one outside it.
name: a lens grinding its own focus
says: It is nearly right. It has been nearly right for a while.
Every pass takes off less than the last.
You will know when it is done.
